news-digest v1.0.5

- Added independent parser for 央广网: separates title and body for correct extraction, preventing titles from being excessively long.
- Implemented authoritative source selection: ensures each key source (e.g., 人民网、新华网、央广网、经济日报等) has at least 2 items in the digest.
- Merged Xinhua sub-channels (e.g., 新华能源、新华科创) into "新华网" for unified attribution.
- Enhanced social news filtering: added keywords to exclude traffic violations and administrative penalty reports.
- Optimized encoding detection: now detects GB2312 from HTML meta tags to improve success on sites like 央广网.
